detail: vi.restoreAllMocks no longer resets the state of spies and only restores spies created manually with vi.spyOn

test.error: FAIL: vi.restoreAllMocks cleared the call history of a vi.fn() mock

source.quote: `vi.restoreAllMocks` no longer resets the state of spies and only restores spies created manually with `vi.spyOn`, automocks are no longer affected by this function
